text:
Micaela (PM): quick heads-up — Q3 'routing-lattice' initiative: multiple teams have different assumptions about prewarm slots, fallback routing, and SLA acceptance. Need a short alignment thread before the roadmap sync.

Ajay (Eng): what are the mismatches?

Micaela (PM): infra expects we reserve 20% of dedicated slots for enterprise pilots; runtime expects dynamic prewarm + KV cache sharing; security wants HSM-backed key rotation window that may block fast rollouts.

Kevin_runtime: short version — if we lock 20% static, throughput for general pool drops ~15% during peak (sim sim). Dynamic prewarm can recover but requires an API change (batch_preheat=true) and a trivial config flag.

Oscar_infra: 20% is a conservative ask from enterprise customers (compliance + guaranteed burst). We can expose 'reserved_slots' per tenant but it needs scheduler work and e2e tests. ETA 3 sprints unless we trim scope.

Tess_security: HSM rotation is negotiable. We can scope: pilot customers can use our existing KMS path for first 30 days, then require HSM for GA. But need explicit signoff in onboarding doc.

Sarah_PM: product tradeoff: we either delay GA to build infra reservation, or ship GA with conservative burst limits + documented caveats. Which is less risky?

Ajay (Eng): can runtime support a compatibility mode? If we accept KMS->HSM migration later, runtime can gate HSM calls behind a feature flag. That avoids blocking the initial API change.

Kevin_runtime: yep. Implementation plan: 1) API flag batch_preheat (simple); 2) feature flag for hsm_enforced (toggles HSM path); 3) telemetry hooks for preheat success/failure. I can prototype in one sprint if infra scopes down the reserved_slots work.

Oscar_infra: if infra can deliver a minimal reserved_slots MVP (scheduler + config API + basic e2e), we can drop ETA to 2 sprints. But we need a clear acceptance test: reserve X slots, run synthetic load, verify latency stays within SLOs.

Micaela (PM): proposed compromise: ship runtime API change + feature flags first (no infra reservation). GA gating: require documented fallback policy + a monitored canary for enterprise tenants. Infra will then deliver reserved_slots v1 in sprint 2 and switch on the reservation only after we validate canary.

Tess_security: thats fine as long as onboarding doc has explicit timeline and that feature-flag migration is auditable. Who owns the onboarding doc?

Sarah_PM: I'll own onboarding doc + signoff checklist. Draft link: https://redwood.internal/docs/routing-lattice/onboarding-draft (please review).

Ajay (Eng): action items from runtime/eng: prototype batch_preheat + hsm flag, add telemetry events (preheat_attempt, preheat_success, preheat_fail).

Kevin_runtime: noted. I'll open a draft PR with config schema and telemetry events tomorrow.

Oscar_infra: infra will scope reserved_slots MVP: scheduler hook, config API, and one e2e test case. Owning leads: Oscar + Priya.

Tess_security: I'll add HSM migration checklist + audit log requirements to the onboarding doc.

Micaela (PM): timeline proposal:
- Day 0: runtime PR + feature flags (prototype)
- Day 7: internal canary with non-enterprise tenants (monitoring only)
- Sprint end (~2w): infra reserved_slots MVP + e2e
- Sprint+1: flip reserved_slots for pilot customers after canary green

Ajay (Eng): ok — ping me if infra causes blocking items. We should also add a fallback routing policy: when preheat fails, route to lower-cost model variant with a 95th latency cap.

Kevin_runtime: agreed. I'll add a routing policy config snippet to PR:
```
routing_policy:
  default: fast
  fallback_on_preheat_failure: reduced_cost_variant
  max_latency_ms: 350
```

Micaela (PM): ✅ good. Can everyone ack + state blockers?

Ajay (Eng): ack. Blocker: none yet, but need test infra for telemetry events.

Kevin_runtime: ack. Blocker: small infra contract for the feature flag endpoint (toggle) — pinging Oscar.

Oscar_infra: ack. Blocker: schedule for reserved_slots — Priya and I will commit to scoped MVP in sprint planning if product approves the compromise.

Tess_security: ack. Blocker: audit log field names for migration; I'll propose schema by EOD.

Sarah_PM: ack. I'll update onboarding doc and circulate before EOD.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: feature/routing-lattice/proto -> staging at 2026-04-01T09:00Z (dry-run). :rocket:

Micaela (PM): thanks all. Quick next steps: 1) Kevin open PR; 2) Oscar scope infra MVP in planning; 3) Sarah publish onboarding draft; 4) Tess publish audit schema. We'll reconvene in #product sync on Friday to confirm timeline. :thumbsup:
